note: Hand-picked, not representative. 'favourable_to' / 'unfavourable_to' are visual impressions of which model's boxes look sensible / questionable in that frame.

cases.why: Water-filled pothole-like cavity (from earlier notes). Old boxes the cavity (plus a very wide box over the cavity and gravel); baseline and candidate box only the gravel/debris patch to its right and not the cavity. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
White lime/paint-like blobs on the road, boxed by all three at similar locations (earlier notes: shared apparent false alarm). Visual impression only; no ground truth.

Round sunken pothole-like area with a darker rim. Old and baseline box the whole area; candidate boxes only the upper rim. Old also has a small box at the top-left corner. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
Same round pothole-like area as C03 (earlier note: baseline-only). Old and baseline box it, candidate has no box in this frame. Visual impression only; no ground truth.

Flush manhole cover in a gravelly lane. Old boxes the cover (0.87), a car-side strip and a box-art object; baseline and candidate do not fire. A manhole is not a pothole by the class definition. Visual impression only; no ground truth.

Sandy depressed area next to a tarpaulin; could be a patch or a pothole-like cavity (unclear). Only old fires, with a tall box including part of the tarpaulin; baseline and candidate silent. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
cases.unfavourable_to: old (box is much larger than the sandy area)

cases.why: Large sandy cavity-like patch at the top of the frame (earlier notes). Old and baseline box it, candidate does not in this frame. Visual impression only; no ground truth.

Repaired strip across the road (looks like a speed-breaker or patch band) with a dark patch and cracked kerb apron. No model boxes the strip here; old boxes two edge regions (kerb apron and top-left road). Visual impression only; no ground truth.
cases.unfavourable_to: old (boxes on kerb apron and plain road)

cases.why: Same repaired strip from another angle. Neither baseline nor candidate boxes the strip itself; candidate boxes the gravelly area left of the strip and the plain road above it, old boxes the kerb apron and the left gravel. Visual impression only; no ground truth.

Ornate worn manhole-like cover and a patch at the top right (earlier notes). Old and candidate box the cover (candidate low confidence 0.39); baseline silent here. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
cases.unfavourable_to: old;candidate (if the cover is not a pothole)

cases.why: Flush manhole cover on smooth tarmac. Candidate boxes it (0.79, plus a small box on the kerb line); old boxes a kerb-side bag/scooter region and a long kerb strip; baseline silent. Visual impression only; no ground truth.

Smooth road next to a white kerb line: baseline boxes plain tarmac beside the line (0.75), old boxes a parked scooter/bag region and a car, candidate silent. No obvious pothole in the boxed areas. Visual impression only; no ground truth.

Faded ring-shaped mark (possibly a cover or old patch) on a blurred dusk road. Baseline boxes the ring (0.67); old returns a near-full-frame box (0.87); candidate silent. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
cases.favourable_to: candidate (if the ring is a real pothole)

cases.why: Wet/water patch on the road (earlier notes: possible shallow pothole). Old and baseline box the wet patch; candidate silent; a smaller wet spot lower down is boxed by nobody. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
cases.unfavourable_to: old;baseline (if wet patches are not potholes)

cases.why: Downward view with a rider's foot at the bottom and patched concrete. Candidate boxes the foot (0.45); old boxes the edge of a water patch at the top; baseline silent. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
Plain tarmac with a tiny pale mark; only the candidate boxes it (0.56). Chosen as a candidate-only small-box example; nothing pothole-like is obvious. Visual impression only; no ground truth.

Residential street with parked cars: old returns a near-full-frame box (0.87) that covers the whole scene; baseline and candidate silent. Typical of the old model's whole-frame boxes on the dusk clips. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
Dusk road with a distant pale patch: old returns a near-full-frame box, candidate boxes a small pale patch (0.72), baseline silent. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
Distant round cover with a dark patched area near it: baseline boxes the round cover (0.67); old returns a near-full-frame box; candidate silent. Visual impression only; no ground truth.
